deep.caption: Japan is divided into 47 administrative prefectures and eight traditional regions, and around 75% of its terrain is mountainous and heavily forested, concentrating its agriculture and highly urbanized population along its eastern coastal plains.

deep.text: Before 日本 was adopted in the early 8th century, the country was known in China as Wa and in Japan by the endonym Yamato.
The name for Japan in Japanese is written using the kanji 日本 and is pronounced Nihon or Nippon.
The first version of the name in English appears in a book published in 1577, which spelled the name as Giapan in a translation of a 1565 Portuguese letter.
Modern humans arrived in Japan around 38,000 years ago, marking the beginning of the Japanese Paleolithic.
Around 14,500 BC, a Mesolithic to Neolithic semi-sedentary hunter-gatherer culture characterized by pit dwelling and rudimentary agriculture emerged.
According to legend, Emperor Jimmu founded a kingdom in central Japan in 660 BC, beginning a continuous imperial line.
The culture of Japan is well known around the world, particularly its popular culture as expressed in animation, art, comics, cuisine, fashion, films, music, television, theater, and video games.
